intent_en: To demonstrate that the vast majority of vaccine doses scheduled for production in 2021 have already been purchased.
previous_intent: To demonstrate the high proportion of planned vaccine production for Pfizer-BioNTech and Moderna that had already been purchased.
narration_support: Pfizer -BioNTech vaccine doses that were scheduled to be produced by the end of the year had already been bought
chart_support: bar chart showing the proportion of Pfizer-BioNTech doses purchased for the year 2021
evidence_note: Narration mentions Moderna (100%) but the chart only displays Pfizer-BioNTech (96%); the intent captures the general pre-purchasing trend for 2021 supplies.
